{{Top|leg|notoc=1}}
The '''parental collective''' were the [[Parent/Legends|guardians]] of [[Cane Adiss/Legends|Cane Adiss]], a [[Yuvernian/Legends|Yuvernian]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] living on<ref name="DB">{{DB|character|caneadiss|Adiss, Cane}}</ref> the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]]<ref name="EAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}} &mdash; Based on corresponding data for [[Yuvern system/Legends|Yuvern system]]</ref> [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Yuvern/Legends|Yuvern]]. The collective would berate him for his aspirations of becoming a [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] and not focusing on his [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]]. When the Yuvernian was an adult, Adiss left Yuvern with the pilot and [[Merchant/Legends|trader]] [[Kal'Falnl C'ndros]].<ref name="DB" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|"Parental Collective" was the only element remaining of my early attempts at describing a social structure for these two-headed beings. Originally, it meant all adults with the responsibility to look over a year's hatching of Yuvernian eggs in a given community. Parentage among Yuvernians was more about what *year* you were hatched, rather than who laid the egg you hatched from.|John Hazlett|<ref name="Blog">{{Blog|jSarek|2|Behind the Scenes - Cane Adiss}}</ref>}}
[[File:CaneAdiss2-SWChronicles.png|thumb|right|200px|The parental collective was intended to be apart of the culture of Yuvernians (member pictured).]]
The parental collective were mentioned in the [[Databank (original)|Databank]] entry for Cane Adiss, written by<ref name="DB" /> [[John Hazlett]],<ref name="Written">{{Hyperspace|url=hyperspace/source/writtenword/index.html?page=1|text=The Written Word|int=The Written Word}}</ref> writing under "JSarek," and published on [[StarWars.com]]<ref name="DB" /> on [[August 31]], [[2006]].<ref name="What's The Story">{{SWArchive|url=databank/updates/news20060831.html|text=What's the Story, Round 6}}</ref> In the published entry, the collective was the only element of the social structure for Yuvernians, though originally Hazlett intended the collective to be all Yuvernian adults with the responsibility of looking over a [[Standard year/Legends|year's]] hatching of the [[Species/Legends|species]]' [[Egg/Legends|eggs]] in the community they were in. The parentage was also envisioned as being more about what year the offspring hatched, rather than the egg's creator. Hazlett, knowing that the entry had to cover these details in the context of Adiss's life, cut them early in writing, but left the term "parental collective" to insinuate the Yuvernian species differed from [[Human/Legends|Humans]] and species similar to them.<ref name="Blog" />
